title: Code and data for: Regularity termination of the Reiner-Rivlin rotating-disk similarity reduction governed by the second normal-stress coefficient
description:
Python code, numerical data and figures that reproduce the numerical results in the manuscript Regularity termination of the Reiner-Rivlin rotating-disk similarity reduction governed by the second normal-stress coefficient.

The archive covers: the negative-K regularity boundary and its closed form lambda_c = 1/(2K), checked over eleven (K, S) cases; the Weissenberg-number collapse 2 Wi2 |lambda_c| = 1; the symbolic comparison with the second-order fluid; the temporal stability analysis by direct generalised eigensolve; the species-block spectrum; the inviscid crossflow diagnostic; the conditioning diagnostic near the regularity boundary; and a comparison of the zero-pressure-gradient and pressure-compatible closures. No molecular-dynamics result is claimed.

The README lists the scripts and the values each one reproduces. REFERENCE_VERIFICATION.md records how each citation was checked.
